# AMD FSR artwork

`amd-fsr-upscaling-white.png` and `amd-fsr-frame-generation-white.png` are
AMD's official white lockups, unmodified, from the
[AMD FSR naming and branding guidelines](https://gpuopen.com/amd-fsr-naming-guidelines/):

| File | Source | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| amd-fsr-upscaling-white.png | https://gpuopen.com/images/253829738-a_amd_fsr_upscaling_lockup_rgb_wht.png | e2d8f99efdf5066410d95f44705352b486d6606a0ab6bef2ac63313c2a939d31 |
| amd-fsr-frame-generation-white.png | https://gpuopen.com/images/253829850-a_amd_fsr_frame_generation_lockup_rgb_wht.png | e397224845c725e11bf4ecf0807663e31ca57936329c47e226b984fd3e77a49e |

They credit AMD FSR in builds that include the AMD FidelityFX SDK, on the
splash screen and in About. AMD, the AMD Arrow logo, AMD FSR and combinations
thereof are trademarks of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. The artwork is not
covered by Abyssal's Apache-2.0 license.
